tactic.request_verbatim: Explain how an inverted right-back turns a 4-3-3 into a 3-2-5 to beat a 4-4-2 mid-block.
tactic.tactic_text: In possession the right-back steps into midfield next to the holding midfielder, the left-back tucks in to form a back three, and the two eights push into the half-spaces so five players pin the opponent's back four.
